info.title: ioviewer
info.description: Command line tool for generating standalone interactive 3D WebGL/HTML BIM & CAD model viewers with no external dependencies that work offline.

options.name: --add
options.description:
Add another model. Translation is in metres and yaw in degrees about +Z.
Repeat the pair for each model. Use 0,0,0,0 for an already aligned source.

options.name: --title
options.description: Page title shown in the browser tab.

options.name: --bcf
options.description: Import topics from a local BCF 2.1 archive in the scene's coordinates.

options.name: --clash
options.description: Check two exact category names for hard clashes after placing all models.

options.name: --clash-clearance
options.description: Check gaps up to this distance instead. Requires --clash.

options.name: --wireframe
options.description: Enable wireframe display mode by default.

options.name: --white-mode
options.description: Enable white/clay architectural rendering mode by default.

options.name: --no-properties
options.description: Exclude element properties to reduce the file size.

options.name: --json
options.description: Export the document as viewer JSON.

options.name: --serve
options.description: Start local HTTP preview server and open in default browser.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show this help message and exit.

options.name: --version
options.description:
Show version information and exit.
Exit codes:
0  Success
1  Usage error (missing or invalid arguments)
2  File not found
3  Data format error, parsing failure, or an output that cannot be written
4  Output written, but the engine adapter reported an error: elements may be missing
5  Output written, but the --serve preview server could not start or failed
Codes 3 and 5 take precedence over 4.

arguments.name: INPUT
arguments.description:
Path to input 3D model (.glb, .obj, .json, .ifc, .ifczip, .rvt, .nwc) or point cloud
(.e57, .las, .laz, .ptg, .rcs, .rcp, .ply, .pcd, .pts, .ptx, .xyz, .csv, .sbf, .fls,
.lgsx, .lgs, .srf, .smf, .c3db, .bin, .pnts).

arguments.name: OUTPUT
arguments.description:
Destination path for exported file (.html, .json or .ivmesh for clustered LOD).
Default: <input-without-ext>.html.
